symptom: MATRA_FILL module: render a word with a BLANK where its matra belongs and let the child drag a matra card into it
evidence: SME asked for this in round 1 and again in round 2 for HI02H11_L02_S01 (ज_ल→ा, पर_→ी, ह_रण→ि); mockup _SME_MOCKUPS/slide16. I substituted a wrong-matra pick and told the SME it was a substitution. Not a card fix: I checked all 59 modules in 2026.08.04b and every module in the reference engines — nothing renders a word with a slot. CRITICAL: the blank index must be into the CONSONANT SEQUENCE, not a character offset — ि is a reordering matra (stored after its consonant, drawn before it), so in हिरण a naive character-offset insert puts the matra in the wrong visual position. Render the blank in the DRAWN position.
